channel.title: Ratecard — AI API pricing changes
channel.description: Dated, sourced changes to published AI API rates.

item.title: OpenAI: correction (2026-10-30)
item.description: gpt-image-2 standard was incorrectly set to batch rates; corrected to $8/$30/$2 (batch $4/$15).

item.title: Anthropic: logic (2026-10-30)
item.description: Haiku 5.5 long-context tier (>100K) now applied in finder/calculator via long_context field.

item.title: Google: logic (2026-10-30)
item.description: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview long-context tier (>200K) now applied via long_context field.

item.title: Mistral: correction (2026-10-30)
item.description: Filled Mistral Large 4 first-party row from 2026-10-29 launch post: $0.70/$2.10 ($0.07 cached).

item.title: Google: scheduled increase (2027-01-01)
item.description: Gemini 3.6 Flash paid tier: input $0.75→$1.50, output $3.75→$7.50, cached $0.075→$0.15 per 1M tokens (batch $0.375→$0.75 / $1.875→$3.75).

item.title: Google: scheduled increase (2027-01-01)
item.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS paid tier: input $0.50→$1.00 (text), output $6.00→$12.00 (audio) per 1M tokens. Row added to the dataset.

item.title: Google: scheduled increase (2027-01-01)
item.description: Gemini Robotics ER 2 Preview and ER 2 Streaming Preview: input $1.00→$2.00, output $5.00→$10.00 per 1M tokens (ER 2 cached $0.10→$0.20). Rows added to the dataset.

item.title: OpenAI: tier renamed (2026-07-30)
item.description: "Priority processing" renamed "Fast mode" (2x standard token price).

item.title: OpenAI: billing start (2026-10-05)
item.description: Billing for gpt-rosalind-research began ($5.00 in / $25.00 out per 1M tokens).

item.title: OpenAI: promotion end (earliest) (2026-11-21)
item.description: GPT-5.6 Sol promotional pricing guaranteed "at least through November 21, 2026" ($4.00 in / $20.00 out).

item.title: Google: scheduled increase (2026-12-01)
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon promotional pricing ends: input $2.00→$4.00, output $10.00→$20.00, cached $0.10→$0.20 per 1M tokens.

item.title: Google: scheduled increase (2027-01-01)
item.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash paid tier: input $0.75→$1.50, output $3.75→$7.50, cached $0.075→$0.15 per 1M tokens. Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS doubles the same day ($0.50→$1.00 in, $9.00→$18.00 out).
